pairs.target: dìèrshíbā tiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi dào běi gōng fāng shí , nài lěi zhèngzài chāi zìjǐ de bāo .
pairs.english: On the afternoon of day twenty-eight, Tavi reached the north workshop to find Nerai unpacking her bag.
pairs.hanzi: 第二十八天下午，塔维到北工坊时，奈蕾正在拆自己的包。

pairs.target: dì shàngpù zhe jiù bù , bù shàng fàng le zhēnxiàn , guǒhǎo de yào , xiǎo kuài féizào , háiyǒu yìzhī kànbùchū yuánlái yánsè de wàzi .
pairs.english: An old cloth lay on the floor, bearing needles and thread, wrapped medicine, a small piece of soap, and a sock whose original color was impossible to tell.
pairs.hanzi: 地上铺着旧布，布上放了针线、裹好的药、小块肥皂，还有一只看不出原来颜色的袜子。

pairs.target: tā bǎ wàzi līn qǐlái , fān le liǎngmiàn , xiàng bú dà yuànyì chéngrèn nà shì zìjǐ de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She lifted the sock and turned it over both ways, looking reluctant to admit it belonged to her.
pairs.hanzi: 她把袜子拎起来，翻了两面，像不大愿意承认那是自己的东西。

pairs.target: " zuò . bié zuò nàbiān , yǒu zhēn . "
pairs.english: “Sit. Not there—there's a needle.”
pairs.hanzi: “坐。别坐那边，有针。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yǐjīng āi dào dèng miàn de tuǐ yòu táiqǐ lái . nài lěi shēnshǒu chōuzǒu yìgēn duǎnzhēn , zhǐ gěi tā kàn , cái bǎ dèngzǐ tuīguòlái .
pairs.english: Tavi lifted his leg away from the stool just as it touched. Nerai plucked out a short needle and showed him before pushing the stool over.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把已经挨到凳面的腿又抬起来。奈蕾伸手抽走一根短针，指给他看，才把凳子推过来。

pairs.target: " yào zǒu le ? " " hòutiān zǎoshàng .
pairs.english: “Are you leaving?” “The morning after tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi:
“要走了？”
“后天早上。

pairs.target: xiān dā huòchē dào fēn lùkǒu , zài qù jiù hékǒu .
pairs.english: First by freight cart to the junction, then to Old Rivermouth.
pairs.hanzi: 先搭货车到分路口，再去旧河口。

pairs.target: cén dù de jiǎo kànguò le , néng zǒu duǎnlù , bùnéng bèi zhòng bāo . tā xiànzài ná zhè jù huà shǐhuàn wǒ . "
pairs.english: Cendu's foot has been examined. He can walk short distances, but can't carry a heavy pack. He's using that to boss me around.”
pairs.hanzi: 岑渡的脚看过了，能走短路，不能背重包。他现在拿这句话使唤我。”

pairs.target: ménwài yǒurén hāi le yìshēng . cén dù bào zhe yígè zhǐbāo jìnlái , jiǎo shàng huàn le kuān xié , zǒu dé bǐ shàngcì màn .
pairs.english: Someone coughed outside. Cendu came in holding a paper package, wearing wider shoes and walking more slowly than last time.
pairs.hanzi: 门外有人咳了一声。岑渡抱着一个纸包进来，脚上换了宽鞋，走得比上次慢。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐbāo fàngxià , shuō lǐmiàn shì gěi dùkǒu nà hù rénjiā dài de yán , búshì tā de zhòng bāo .
pairs.english: He set down the package, saying it held salt for the family at the ferry, not his heavy pack.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸包放下，说里面是给渡口那户人家带的盐，不是他的重包。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiào tā zìjǐ bǎ yán fènchéng liǎngfèn , tā biàn zuòzài ménkǎn shàng chāi shéng .
pairs.english: Nerai told him to divide the salt into two portions himself, so he sat on the doorstep untying the string.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾叫他自己把盐分成两份，他便坐在门槛上拆绳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe jiù bù shàng de dōngxī . tāmen yìdiǎndiǎn shōu jìn bāo lǐ , gōng fāng què xiàng gēnzhe kōngxiàqù le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi watched the things on the old cloth. As they went into the bag one by one, the workshop seemed to grow a little emptier too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着旧布上的东西。它们一点点收进包里，工坊却像跟着空下去了一点。

pairs.target: nài lěi qiánjǐcì yě zài zhěnglǐxíngzhuāng , tā bìng méiyǒu zhèyàng zǐxì kànguò .
pairs.english: Nerai had packed on previous visits as well, but he had never watched so closely.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾前几次也在整理行装，他并没有这样仔细看过。

pairs.target: " zhècì huì bǎ dùkǒu xiūhǎo ma ? " " xiānjiàn rén .
pairs.english: “Will you fix the ferry this time?” “First we meet the people.
pairs.hanzi:
“这次会把渡口修好吗？”
“先见人。

pairs.target: huíxìn shuō , tāmen kěnxiàlái tán , dàn bùkěn zhī píng yíjù huà bānhuílái .
pairs.english: Their reply says they will come down to talk, but won't move back on a mere promise.
pairs.hanzi: 回信说，他们肯下来谈，但不肯只凭一句话搬回来。

pairs.target: xīn suǒ shénme shíhòu dào , hái dé qù jiēhuò de dìfāng wèn . "
pairs.english: We still have to ask at the receiving depot when the new cable will arrive.”
pairs.hanzi: 新索什么时候到，还得去接货的地方问。”

pairs.target: cén dù bǎ yán zhǐ yāpíng , bǔ le yíjù : " shǒu dù de rén xiànzài zài shàngyóu bāngmáng chēngchuán , yě búshì zuò zhe děng wǒmen . "
pairs.english: Cendu smoothed the salt paper and added, “The ferry keeper's helping work boats upstream now, not sitting waiting for us.”
pairs.hanzi: 岑渡把盐纸压平，补了一句：“守渡的人现在在上游帮忙撑船，也不是坐着等我们。”

pairs.target: nài lěi diǎntóu , bǎ zhǔnbèi hǎo de tú zhuāngjìn yóubù tào .
pairs.english: Nerai nodded and put the prepared drawings in an oilcloth sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾点头，把准备好的图装进油布套。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ tā shàngcì jìchūqù de bāo , yuánlái yìfēng huíxìn yě bùnéng ràng suǒyǒu shìqíng yìqǐ wǎngqiánzǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the parcel she'd sent last time. One reply couldn't move everything forward together after all.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起她上次寄出去的包，原来一封回信也不能让所有事情一起往前走。

pairs.target: " wǒ hòutiān yě chūmén . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I'm going out the day after tomorrow too,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “我后天也出门。”他说。

pairs.target: nài lěi táiqǐ tóu . tā bǎ lùxiàn dān dìguòqù , shuō shì wéi lǎoshī dàiduì , qù xīmiàn de jiù zhuǎnyùnzhàn .
pairs.english: Nerai looked up. He handed over the route sheet, explaining that Instructor Vey was taking them to the old transfer station in the west.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾抬起头。他把路线单递过去，说是维老师带队，去西面的旧转运站。

pairs.target: tā kàn wán , ná zhǐjié qiāoqiāo zhǐ shàng huà qiáo de dìfāng .
pairs.english: After reading it, she tapped the bridge drawn on the sheet with her knuckle.
pairs.hanzi: 她看完，拿指节敲敲纸上画桥的地方。

pairs.target: " zǒu shàngmiàn de qiáo ? " " dān shàng zhème huà . "
pairs.english: “Taking the upper bridge?” “That's what the sheet shows.”
pairs.hanzi:
“走上面的桥？”
“单上这么画。”

pairs.target: " nàbiān néng kànjiàn jiù chēdào . nǐ cóng shàngmiàn kàn , cái zhīdào yǐqián yíliàngchē dé guǎi duōshǎo wān . "
pairs.english: “You can see the old cart road from there. From above, you will see how many turns a cart used to make.”
pairs.hanzi: “那边能看见旧车道。你从上面看，才知道以前一辆车得拐多少弯。”

pairs.target: tā děng zhe tā zàishuō shénme wēixiǎn , tā què wèn tāmen dàibudài wǔfàn .
pairs.english: He waited for her to mention dangers, but instead she asked whether they were bringing lunch.
pairs.hanzi: 他等着她再说什么危险，她却问他们带不带午饭。

pairs.target: tīngjiàn fàntáng huì zhuāng bǐng , tā zhòu le yíxià bízi .
pairs.english: On hearing the dining hall would pack flatbread, she wrinkled her nose.
pairs.hanzi: 听见饭堂会装饼，她皱了一下鼻子。

pairs.target: " bié bǎ shuǐ dǎo zài bǐng dài lǐ . wǒ gān guò , zǒu dào zhōngwǔ zhī shèng yídài hú . "
pairs.english: “Don't pour your water into the bread bag. I did that once. By noon I had nothing but a bag of mush.”
pairs.hanzi: “别把水倒在饼袋里。我干过，走到中午只剩一袋糊。”

pairs.target: cén dù méi táitóu , xiào dé yán sā le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Cendu laughed without looking up, spilling a little salt.
pairs.hanzi: 岑渡没抬头，笑得盐撒了一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánběn xiǎng wèn néng bunéng gēn tā zǒu yìxiǎo duàn .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to ask whether he could go part of the way with her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原本想问能不能跟她走一小段。

pairs.target: zìjǐ de lùxiàn dān jiù zài xī shàng , hé tā nà zhāng mǎn shì zhéhén de tú gé zhe bànzhāng zhuōzi , tā cái fāxiàn zhè búshì yítàng huàn gè dàiduì rén jiù néng zǒu de lù .
pairs.english: His route sheet lay on his knees, half a table away from her much-folded map; only then did he realize this wasn't a journey he could take simply by changing guides.
pairs.hanzi: 自己的路线单就在膝上，和她那张满是折痕的图隔着半张桌子，他才发现这不是一趟换个带队人就能走的路。

pairs.target: " nǐ shénme shíhòu huílái ? " " dǎsuàn shíèrtiān zuǒyòu .
pairs.english: “When will you be back?” “I'm aiming for around twelve days.
pairs.hanzi:
“你什么时候回来？”
“打算十二天左右。

pairs.target: yàoshi dé duō liú , wǒhuì xiān sòngxìn . zhège shíhòu wǒ hái bùnéng tì biérén bǎ rìzi dìng sǐ . "
pairs.english: If I need to stay longer, I will send word first. Right now I can't fix other people's dates for them.”
pairs.hanzi: 要是得多留，我会先送信。这个时候我还不能替别人把日子定死。”

pairs.target: shíèrtiān . tǎ wéi suànle yíxià , yǐjīng kuài dào shìdú jiéshù .
pairs.english: Twelve days. Tavi worked it out: nearly the end of his trial.
pairs.hanzi: 十二天。塔维算了一下，已经快到试读结束。

pairs.target: nài lěi kànjiàn tā zài shù shǒuzhǐ , tíngxià le shōu bāo .
pairs.english: Nerai saw him counting on his fingers and stopped packing.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看见他在数手指，停下了收包。

pairs.target: " xuégōng nàbiān wǒ liú guò xīn xíngchéng le .
pairs.english: “I have left my new itinerary with the academy.
pairs.hanzi: “学宫那边我留过新行程了。

pairs.target: liùzhōu de píngdìng yóu shòukè de rén zuò , búyòng děng wǒ huílái qiān .
pairs.english: Your teachers conduct the six-week assessment. They don't need to wait for my signature.
pairs.hanzi: 六周的评定由授课的人做，不用等我回来签。

pairs.target: yào zhǎo wǒ , jiùràng běi gōng fāng àn zhège dìfāng zhuǎn xìn . "
pairs.english: If you need me, have the north workshop forward a letter to this address.”
pairs.hanzi: 要找我，就让北工坊按这个地方转信。”

pairs.target: tā náchū yìzhāng xiǎo zhǐ , xiě de shì fēn lùkǒu huòzhàn de zhuǎnjiāo chù , xiàmiàn hái xiě le lìng yígè fùzé shōu xiāoxī de míngzì .
pairs.english: She took out a slip listing the forwarding desk at the junction freight depot, with another contact's name below.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿出一张小纸，写的是分路口货栈的转交处，下面还写了另一个负责收消息的名字。

pairs.target: tā zhúxíng niàn gěi tā tīng , ràng tā bǎ bú rènshi de zì quān chūlái , méi bǎ zhǐ sāi gěi tā biàn suàn wánshì .
pairs.english: She read it line by line, having him circle unfamiliar characters rather than simply handing him the paper and stopping there.
pairs.hanzi: 她逐行念给他听，让他把不认识的字圈出来，没把纸塞给他便算完事。

pairs.target: " méi dào nàbiān , yě néng shōudào ? "
pairs.english: “You will get it even if you haven't arrived?”
pairs.hanzi: “没到那边，也能收到？”

pairs.target: " tāmen xiān liú zhe . wǒ qù dùkǒu qián huì qǔ yícì , huíchéng zài qǔ .
pairs.english: “They will hold it. I will collect mail before going to the ferry, then again on the way back.
pairs.hanzi: “他们先留着。我去渡口前会取一次，回程再取。

pairs.target: jíshì ràng gōng fāng xiě míngbái , bùnéng zhǐwàng pǔtōng xìn zhuī zhe jiǎo pǎo . "
pairs.english: For anything urgent, have the workshop mark it clearly. Ordinary mail can't be expected to run after my feet.”
pairs.hanzi: 急事让工坊写明白，不能指望普通信追着脚跑。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xiǎo zhǐjiá jìn jìlùběn , nuó le liǎngcì , pà tā cóng pò jiǎo lòuchūqù .
pairs.english: Tavi tucked the slip into his notebook, shifting it twice for fear it might escape through the torn corner.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把小纸夹进记录本，挪了两次，怕它从破角漏出去。

pairs.target: nài lěi kànjiàn lǐmiàn de kèxiàn , wèn tā zuìjìn zuò le shénme .
pairs.english: Nerai noticed the graduation marks inside and asked what he'd been doing recently.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看见里面的刻线，问他最近做了什么。

pairs.target: tā shuō néng tíngzhù yìdiǎn le , yòu gǎnjǐn bǔ shàng , hái búdào lǎoshī zhǐdìng de wèizhì , yě méi shì gòu cìshù .
pairs.english: He said he could hold a small change now, then hastily added that it was short of the teacher's target and hadn't been tried enough times.
pairs.hanzi: 他说能停住一点了，又赶紧补上，还不到老师指定的位置，也没试够次数。

pairs.target: " nà yě huà gěi wǒ kàn . "
pairs.english: “Draw it for me anyway.”
pairs.hanzi: “那也画给我看。”

pairs.target: tā zài kōng zhǐ shàng huà xià liǎngpiàn gāngtiáo , bǎ zìjǐ tíng guò de dìfāng hé yāoqiú de wèizhì fēnkāi .
pairs.english: He drew the two steel strips on blank paper, separating the place he'd held from the required position.
pairs.hanzi: 他在空纸上画下两片钢条，把自己停过的地方和要求的位置分开。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le yíhuìer , wèn nǎ yìbǐ shì yuánlái bú dòng de wèizhì . tā bǔ shàng yǐhòu , tā cái diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Nerai studied it and asked which line showed the original resting position. Only after he added it did she nod.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看了一会儿，问哪一笔是原来不动的位置。他补上以后，她才点头。

pairs.target: " wǒ dài zhè zhāng . " " hái méi huà hǎo . "
pairs.english: “I will take this one.” “It isn't finished.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我带这张。”
“还没画好。”

pairs.target: " wǒ kàndédǒng jiù xíng . hòumiàn yǒu xīn de , jì lái . "
pairs.english: “I can read it; that's enough. Send me the next ones.”
pairs.hanzi: “我看得懂就行。后面有新的，寄来。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán yǒuxiē shèbùdé nà zhāng wāi tú , yòu juéde shèbùdé dé méidàolǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly hated parting with the crooked drawing, then felt silly for minding.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然有些舍不得那张歪图，又觉得舍不得得没道理。

pairs.target: tā bǎ biānshàng zhān de miànbāoxiè fúdiào , dìguòqù .
pairs.english: He brushed the bread crumbs from the edge and handed it over.
pairs.hanzi: 他把边上沾的面包屑拂掉，递过去。

pairs.target: línzǒuqián , tā xiǎngqǐ dài lǐ nà piàn jiù tánhuáng , bǎ bāo zhe tā de bù tān zài zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: Before leaving, he remembered the old spring in his bag and spread its wrapping cloth on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 临走前，他想起袋里那片旧弹簧，把包着它的布摊在桌上。

pairs.target: liǎngdào xiāngduì de yuè yáyìn zài biānjiǎo , yǐjīng bèi tā mō dé hěn shú .
pairs.english: The two facing crescent marks at the corner were already familiar beneath his touch.
pairs.hanzi: 两道相对的月牙印在边角，已经被他摸得很熟。

pairs.target: " yǐhòu chá zhèyàng de yìn , qù nǎlǐ chá ? "
pairs.english: “Where would you look up a mark like this?”
pairs.hanzi: “以后查这样的印，去哪里查？”

pairs.target: nài lěi méi shuō zìjǐ rènde . tā jiào tā xiān huà xià dàxiǎo hé pángbiān nà dào quēkǒu , huítóu kěyǐ wèn xuégōng bǎoguǎn jiù gōngliào cè de rén .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't claim to recognize it. She told him to draw its size and the notch beside it first, then ask whoever kept the academy's old material ledgers.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没说自己认得。她叫他先画下大小和旁边那道缺口，回头可以问学宫保管旧工料册的人。

pairs.target: yígè yìn yòng le duōjiǔ , nǎxiēdìfāng jiēguò huò , yào fān cèzǐ ; bùnéng zhī kàn xíngzhuàng xiàng .
pairs.english: How long a mark had been used and which places had received goods required looking through ledgers; resemblance alone wasn't enough.
pairs.hanzi: 一个印用了多久、哪些地方接过货，要翻册子；不能只看形状像。

pairs.target: " děng nǐ huílái zài qù ? " " nǐ kěyǐ xiān wèn . chá dào shénme , yě xiěgěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “After you get back?” “You can ask first. Write to me about anything you find.”
pairs.hanzi:
“等你回来再去？”
“你可以先问。查到什么，也写给我。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ tánhuáng chóngxīn guǒhǎo . ménkǎn shàng de cén dù yǐjīng fēn wán yán , zhèng ná zhe nà zhī wàzi wèn , bāo zhège xíngbùxíng .
pairs.english: Tavi wrapped the spring again. Cendu had finished dividing the salt on the doorstep and was holding the sock, asking whether he could wrap it in that.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把弹簧重新裹好。门槛上的岑渡已经分完盐，正拿着那只袜子问，包这个行不行。

pairs.target: nài lěi shēnshǒu qù qiǎng . tā cèshēn duǒkāi , yánbāo què wěnwěn liúzài xī shàng .
pairs.english: Nerai reached to snatch it. He twisted aside, keeping the salt packages steady on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾伸手去抢。他侧身躲开，盐包却稳稳留在膝上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe chūlemén , zǒu dào yuànzi lǐ cái bǎ nà zhāng zhuǎn xìn dìzhǐ yòu mō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi went out laughing. Only in the courtyard did he again feel for the forwarding address.
